title: Successful People
subtitle: I heard on the internet, probably from sam altman

content.text: I heard on the internet, probably from sam altman, who seemed to have heard it from qi lu, where he said:
“Successful people create big company. More successful people create big country. The most successful people create big religion.”
It really seems soo true. The most successful people creates religion. And I guess, the sucessful founders tries to do that as well, and instead end up making a great company.
